name: Push-ups
instructions: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Lower your chest to just above the floor and push back up.

name: Knee push-ups
instructions: Same as a push-up but with knees on the floor. Keep hips in line with your back.

name: Incline push-ups
instructions: Place hands on a bench or table and do push-ups at an angle.

name: Decline push-ups
instructions: Feet on a raised surface, hands on the floor. Lower slowly and press up.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench, press dumbbells up over your chest and lower them slowly to chest level.

name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Set the bench to 30 degrees and press dumbbells up and slightly together.

name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Grip slightly wider than shoulders, lower the bar to mid-chest and press up. Use a spotter for heavy sets.

name: Chest press machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles are at chest height. Press forward and return slowly.

name: Cable fly
instructions: With a slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in front of your chest.

name: Parallel bar dips
instructions: Lean slightly forward and lower until elbows reach 90 degrees, then press up.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades, then return slowly.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall and pull the handle to your stomach. Keep your back straight.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Support yourself on a bench and row the dumbbell to your hip.

name: Barbell row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and row the bar to your lower chest.

name: Inverted rows
instructions: Hang under a sturdy table or bar and pull your chest up to it.

name: Pull-ups
instructions: Hang from a bar and pull until your chin is over it. Lower with control.

name: Superman hold
instructions: Lie face down and lift arms and legs off the floor. Hold.

name: Barbell deadlift
instructions: Keep the bar close, back flat, and stand up by driving through your legs. Learn the form with light weight first.

name: Dumbbell pullover
instructions: Lie across a bench and lower one dumbbell behind your head with straight arms, then pull it back over your chest.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Seated or standing, press dumbbells overhead and lower to ear level.

name: Lateral raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows.

name: Front raise
instructions: Lift dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height and lower slowly.

name: Pike push-ups
instructions: Hips high in an upside-down V, bend elbows to lower your head toward the floor and press up.

name: Arnold press
instructions: Start with palms facing you, rotate them outward as you press overhead.

name: Barbell overhead press
instructions: Press the bar from your collarbone to overhead, keeping your core tight.

name: Face pull
instructions: Pull the rope toward your face with elbows high, squeezing your upper back.

name: Plank shoulder taps
instructions: In a high plank, tap each shoulder with the opposite hand while keeping hips still.

name: Dumbbell bicep curl
instructions: Keep elbows at your sides and curl the dumbbells up, then lower slowly.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Curl with palms facing each other.

name: Bench tricep dips
instructions: Hands on a bench behind you, lower your body by bending elbows and push back up.

name: Overhead tricep extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower behind your head and extend.

name: Cable tricep pushdown
instructions: Keep elbows tucked and push the bar down until arms are straight.

name: Barbell curl
instructions: Curl the bar to your shoulders without swinging your back.

name: Diamond push-ups
instructions: Form a diamond with your hands under your chest and do push-ups.

name: Bodyweight squats
instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, sit back until thighs are parallel to the floor, then stand.

name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and squat down, keeping your chest up.

name: Walking lunges
instructions: Step forward and lower until both knees are at 90 degrees. Alternate legs.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.

name: Calf raises
instructions: Rise onto your toes, pause, and lower slowly. Use a step for more range.

name: Dumbbell step-ups
instructions: Step onto a sturdy box or bench, drive through the front heel and step down.

name: Leg press
instructions: Push the platform away without locking your knees, then return slowly.

name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Bar on upper back, brace your core and squat to parallel. Use safety bars.

name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: With soft knees, hinge at the hips and lower the weights along your legs, then stand up.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Rear foot on a bench, lower your back knee toward the floor and drive up through the front leg.

name: Jump squats
instructions: Squat down then jump explosively. Land softly and go straight into the next rep.

name: Pistol squat
instructions: Squat on one leg with the other leg straight out in front. Hold a support if needed.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on the floor, body in a straight line. Hold without letting hips drop.

name: Side plank
instructions: Support yourself on one forearm with hips lifted. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, and curl your shoulders off the floor.

name: Bicycle crunches
instructions: Bring opposite elbow to knee while extending the other leg, alternating sides.

name: Dead bug
instructions: On your back, lower opposite arm and leg toward the floor while keeping your lower back flat.

name: Russian twists
instructions: Sit with feet raised, lean back slightly and rotate side to side.

name: Mountain climbers
instructions: From a high plank, drive knees toward your chest quickly, one at a time.

name: Lying leg raises
instructions: Lie flat, keep legs straight and raise them to 90 degrees, then lower slowly.

name: Cable woodchop
instructions: Pull the cable diagonally across your body, rotating through your torso.

name: Hanging knee raises
instructions: Hang from a bar and bring your knees up toward your chest without swinging.

name: Burpees
instructions: Squat, kick back to a plank, do a push-up, jump feet in and jump up.

name: Dumbbell thrusters
instructions: Squat with dumbbells at your shoulders, then stand and press them overhead in one motion.

name: Dumbbell deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your legs, hinge at the hips and stand up with a flat back.

name: Inchworm
instructions: Bend forward, walk your hands out to a plank, then walk them back and stand.

name: Bear crawl
instructions: On hands and feet with knees just off the floor, crawl forward and back.

name: Squat to press (bodyweight)
instructions: Squat down, then stand and reach both arms overhead.

name: Barbell clean and press
instructions: Pull the bar from the floor to your shoulders, then press overhead. Learn with a coach first.

name: Brisk walking
instructions: Walk fast enough that talking is slightly harder than normal.

name: Jumping jacks
instructions: Jump feet out while raising arms overhead, then return.

name: High knees
instructions: Run in place, bringing knees up to hip height. Rest 30 seconds every minute.

name: Stationary cycling
instructions: Cycle at a steady, moderate pace.

name: Jogging
instructions: Jog at a pace where you can still speak in short sentences.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Skip with small jumps, landing on the balls of your feet.

name: Stair climbing
instructions: Climb stairs at a steady pace, walking down to recover.

name: Rowing machine
instructions: Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your ribs.

name: HIIT intervals
instructions: Alternate 30 seconds of hard effort (sprints, burpees) with 30 seconds of rest.
